question: Which of the following is the debut novel of Indian novelist Chetan Bhagat, who received the Society Young Achievers Award and the Publisher’s Recognition award for his works?

options.text: The Three Mistakes of My Life

solution:
The correct answer is__** Five point someone**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In** five Point Someone**, he describes the perennial themes like **parental pressure on children for getting admission in highly competitive institute, earn high grades, get a good job, poverty, exploitation at job place, ill effects of domestic quarrel** etc.
 
• In** five point someone** by **Chetan Bhagat , **three friends spend four years in the IIT. Alok , Hari and Ryan three dormitory roommates ,have a miserable first day at IIT since they fail the first quiz .
 
• the novel is based somewhat on** Bhagat's own life and is considered a semi-autobiographical work.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** three mistakes of my life** was written by** Chetan Bhagat. **the story of three friends is followed throughout the book,which is set** in western indian city Ahmedabad **
 
• **Chetan bhagat **published a book in 2011 titled** Revolution 2020 Love, corruption, ambition . **A love triangle , corruption and a quest for self discovery are all themes in the novel
 
• **Chetan bhagat** published a collection of his lectures and articles titled **What Young India Wants . **It centres on Indian politics and society from the view point of the nations youth.
